cards.t: THORChain Restarts Swaps as RUNE Rallies
cards.b: THORChain has successfully restored trading on Bitcoin, Ethereum, and several other networks following a temporary refund bug halt, though three chains remain paused.

per.RUNE: Rallied significantly as protocol trading and multi-chain swaps resumed.

cards.label: STRONG CATALYST
cards.missing: Exact timeline for resuming the remaining three paused chains.

cards.t: SEC Division Views Canton Coin as Digital Commodity via No-Action Letter
cards.b: SEC staff issued a no-action letter viewing Canton Coin as a digital commodity for programmatic issuance earned by running infrastructure and applications.

per.CC: Receives regulatory clarity as SEC staff will not recommend enforcement regarding its programmatic issuance.

cards.label: STRONG CATALYST
cards.missing: Whether the no-action letter will face broader Commission-level review or formal rulemaking.

cards.t: Collector Crypt's CARDS Added to Coinbase Roadmap
cards.b: Coinbase has added Collector Crypt's CARDS token to its listing roadmap, driving positive price action.

per.CARDS: Added to Coinbase listing roadmap, boosting token price and market interest.

cards.label: STRONG CATALYST
cards.missing: Exact trading start date on Coinbase.

cards.t: Zcash Privacy Pool Sprout Freezes Remainder Funds
cards.b: Zcash is moving to freeze approximately 12,200 remaining ZEC in its oldest privacy pool, Sprout, while the grants committee withdrew a separate plan to redirect 98,000 ZEC to mining rewards.

per.ZEC: Sprout privacy pool assets are being frozen as outflow velocity slows and governance proposals are adjusted.

cards.label: STRONG CATALYST
cards.missing: Final execution date for the complete Sprout pool freeze.

cards.t: Bybit Lists KOR Protocol Token with Reward Pool
cards.b: Bybit is listing the KOR Protocol token accompanied by a 40 million KOR reward pool, alongside live airdrop claims.

per.KOR: Listing on Bybit with a 40 million KOR reward pool and active airdrop claims.

cards.label: STRONG CATALYST

cards.t: Moscow Exchange to List Bitcoin and USDT in December
cards.b: Russia’s U.S.-sanctioned Moscow Exchange announced plans to list bitcoin and Tether's USDT in December to capture overseas crypto trading volume.

per.BTC: Gains a regulated listing venue on the Moscow Exchange.
per.USDT: Set for official listing on Russia's primary bourse in December.

cards.label: MODERATE CATALYST
cards.missing: Exact launch date in December and trading pair specifications.

cards.t: Schroders Launches Tokenized Emerging Markets Debt Fund on Solana
cards.b: Global asset manager Schroders has brought its actively managed emerging markets bond strategy onchain through tokenization specialist Centrifuge, utilizing the Solana blockchain.

per.SOL: Expands its ecosystem with a tokenized bond fund managed by a $1T+ asset manager via Centrifuge.

cards.label: COMPLETED CATALYST
cards.missing: Total asset migration volume and initial yield targets.
